description: Verify an Ed25519-signed citation receipt previously issued by /api/cite/:grant_id. Confirms (a) signature matches LocalGov.jp pubkey, (b) receipt has not expired. Local crypto, no network. If `pubkey` is omitted, the live pubkey is fetched from /.well-known/citation-pubkey for trust anchoring.

expected_pubkey.description: Expected base64 Ed25519 public key. Omit to fetch the live key.

receipt.description: The full receipt JSON envelope returned by /api/cite/:id

name: verify_receipt
